label: HOME (390px, light)
verdict:
VERDICT: FAIL

BRAND-COLOR: No — background is plain white/grey, accent is a pale blue-green chip only; no warm cream or bright aqua/teal identity.

PHOTOGRAPHY: Doctors have real portrait photos, but hospital tiles use letter-initial circles (CH, QB); avatars are not square-rounded — doctor photos read as squares with only slight rounding.

LIFE/DELIGHT: Mostly flat; one "live" dot and doctor photos help, but the primary button lacks presence/soft shadow and hospital cards are letter-icon dead weight.

READABILITY: "97 doctors · 13 hospitals · 69 visits booked — live" line is low-contrast grey and small; footer links are faint; no clipping observed.

STRUCTURE: Fees (₹300/visit) visible on doctor cards before tap — good; but no single dominant primary action (no clear CTA button), and horizontal carousels are both cut mid-card.

NITPICKS:
1. Horizontal cards clipped at right edge with no affordance/carousel hint (major).
2. Hospital tiles show "0 doctors · 1 department" — booking a hospital with zero doctors is confusing (minor).
3. No dominant primary CTA (e.g., "Book now") — screen is a passive directory (major).

label: DOCTOR PROFILE (390px, light)
verdict:
VERDICT: FAIL

BRAND-COLOR: Barely present — background is effectively white/neutral grey; no warm cream base and no aqua/teal accent family anywhere on the screen.

PHOTOGRAPHY: Yes — a real doctor photo renders (not letter initials), but it's a square-rounded portrait with a black edge/crop artifact at the bottom, which looks sloppy.

LIFE/DELIGHT: Mostly flat — the only soft-shadow element is the pill "Back" button; the primary CTA is a flat black slab with no shadow or depth, and there are no pulse/live accents despite "visits/patients" stats that could carry them.

READABILITY: Grey-on-white secondary text ("2 yrs · MD · Gandhinagar", "17 visits · 4 patients") sits near the low-contrast threshold; nothing appears clipped.

STRUCTURE: Fee is clearly visible before tap (₹300 card + echoed in CTA), and there is exactly one dominant primary action ("Book appointment — ₹300") — good; but the CTA is black, not brand accent.

NITPICKS:
1. Primary CTA is colorless black with no soft shadow/accent — kills brand identity and delight (major).
2. Doctor photo has a hard black bottom edge/letterbox artifact from cropping (minor).
3. No warm cream background or aqua/teal accent anywhere — screen reads as a generic monochrome app (major).
